title: Formula Book
text:
# Formula Book

A curated index of formulas. Keep derivations, assumptions and examples in the relevant topic note.

## QA
- Arithmetic: [[../01 Quantitative Aptitude/QA Index#Arithmetic]]
- Algebra: [[../01 Quantitative Aptitude/QA Index#Algebra]]
- Geometry: [[../01 Quantitative Aptitude/QA Index#Geometry & Mensuration]]
- Number Systems: [[../01 Quantitative Aptitude/QA Index#Number Systems]]
- Modern Mathematics: [[../01 Quantitative Aptitude/QA Index#Modern Mathematics]]

## Formula entry standard
For every formula, record:
1. Formula
2. Meaning of each variable
3. Conditions under which it applies
4. One short example
5. A common misuse or trap

# CAT Study Plan

## Principles
- Prioritise consistency over unrealistic daily targets.
- Practise all three sections throughout preparation.
- Track accuracy, time spent, question selection and error patterns.
- Analyse mocks deeply; taking a mock without analysis has limited value.

## Weekly planner
| Day | QA | VARC | DILR | Review |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monday | | | | |
| Tuesday | | | | |
| Wednesday | | | | |
| Thursday | | | | |
| Friday | | | | |
| Saturday | | | | |
| Sunday | | | | |

## Study session log
| Date | Section/topic | Planned task | Actual work | Accuracy | Reflection |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---|
| | | | | | |

## Mock strategy
- Before: decide the purpose of the mock (baseline, strategy test, or exam simulation).
- During: note question selection and time allocation.
- After: classify every missed, guessed and skipped question.
- Follow up: practise the underlying concept and revisit the error after a few days.
